attack: a hand-typed AUDIT: PASS with no audit-report block at all
why: prose cannot prove origin; the gate must refuse a report nobody can attribute, and name the missing provenance
wouldBeWrongIf: the gate returned READY, or refused with AUDIT_FAILED/AUDIT_STALE (which would not say the report cannot be attributed to all.mjs)

allowedSecondary.AUDIT_TREE_CHANGED: no block means no claimed tree; this fires because the claim is missing, not because a foreign tree was detected
allowedSecondary.AUDIT_FIDELITY_MISMATCH: follows from the missing block: there is nothing to compare
allowedSecondary.AUDIT_CORPUS_UNMEASURED: no block, so no corpus.dir and no file list to re-read
allowedSecondary.AUDIT_CHECKS_ABSENT: the block that would carry checks{} is absent
allowedSecondary.AUDIT_ID_MISMATCH: with no block there is no claimed id to recompute, so the derivation check fails on the absence
allowedSecondary.AUDIT_VERDICT_CONTRADICTION: with no machine block there is no second verdict to agree with, so the contradiction check reads the absence as disagreement
allowedSecondary.AUDIT_INCOMPLETE: depends on which headings the hand-typed text kept
